source: Supernote Manta (A5X2), adb device SN100D20051174, system apps under /system_ext/app, pulled with adb pull, read with aapt2 dump badging and aapt2 dump xmltree, 2026-11-25 (#271)

vector.from: launcher icons that are vector drawables: Settings (com.ratta.settings res/sn1.xml), To-Do (supernote.task res/lO.xml), Calendar (supernote.calendar res/-I.xml), Email (supernote.email res/qT.xml), Digest (supernote.knowledge res/Rs.xml)
vector.inkMarginNote: the stroke outline (centerline +- 2) of Settings, Digest and Email reaches 2 from the edge of the 48 box; this is the launcher icons' margin
vector.inkSpanNote: the span icons.py fits a launcher icon's stroke outline to, on its longer side: one unit under the native launchers' 44 of 48, so rounding never crosses their margin

bitmap.from: launcher icons that are bitmaps: Note (supernote.note res/vD.png) and Document (supernote.document res/A_.png), 64 x 64 grey with alpha, measured on the pixels

tile.note: the README shows each icon at 48 px on this light rounded tile, drawn into the PNG because GitHub strips CSS, so a black icon reads on GitHub's dark theme too; the radius is the Ink Notebook Editor's 230 of 1024; the tablet's own icons stay as they are (#304)

exception: InkHub (res/vx.xml) is a filled black vector; it is the one native icon that is not an outline and is not followed

toolbar.from: the Note app's (com.ratta.supernote.note) 64 x 64 toolbar and lasso icons, 71 that draw on white, read on their pixels (dark below 50%), 2026-11-25 (#271)
toolbar.inkMarginNote: the median smallest gap between the ink and the box, over the four sides; the selected states, which fill their whole box, are left out
toolbar.strokeNote: re-measured 2026-11-25 (#271, third pass): across each straight run of ink in a row or column, the sum of its pixel darkness is the stroke width, anti-aliasing included; 32 of the 41 single-stroke icons give 4 px
toolbar.use: recorded as a measurement only; plugin icons follow `official` since 2026-11-26 (#450)

official.from: the Sticker plugin's own icon file (icon.png of plugin_sticker 0.1.124, the system plugin that PluginHost ships in its APK's assets/plugins/plugin_sticker.snplg), 48 x 48 grey with alpha, read on its pixels as `toolbar` is, Manta, 2026-11-26 (#450)
official.strokeNote: the sum of pixel darkness across the ring where it runs straight across a row or column (rows 22 to 26 and columns 20 to 26 at the ring's left and bottom), 4.0 px each
official.screen: Settings > Plugins on the Manta, screenshot at screen pixels (1920 x 2560), 2026-11-26 (#450): the Sticker and Palette (a third-party plugin, 0.6.2) icons span 52 px with a 4.6 px stroke; every Ink Tools icon spanned 34 to 36 px with a 3.6 px stroke, 0.69 of theirs, as the tablet scales every icon file into the same box of about 57 px

plugin.note: Plugin icons are 96 x 96 PNGs; the tablet scales a lasso row to 60 px (docs/supernote.md). Each plugin icon is built from Tabler glyphs on their 24 grid, scaled about its centre so its stroke outline spans the `reference` icons' inkSpanPx of their sizePx on its longer side, and centred; it is written with `padding` units around the grid (viewBox -5 -5 34 34) and a stroke of the reference's strokePx of its sizePx of the box (#450).

tile.note: the landing page shows every tool's icon, plugin, app, Mac app or command line, drawn as a plugin icon is (stroke and margin) on this warm rounded tile; the padding is under the README tile's 0.2, so the glyph is a little larger in its tile (#439)
